purpose: Bounded paired scheduler diagnostic for P2-B: determine whether watch coalescing reduces writer submissions while preserving all synthetic changes.
not_a_claim: This mock-executor diagnostic does not measure native indexing CPU or complete native lifecycle wall time.
Its event-to-writer-start lag is not the P1 event-to-visible freshness metric.
It does not independently qualify query p95 or production performance.
command: cd rust && cargo test --locked -p zg-daemon --lib watch_burst_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture

workload.executor: TimedBenchmarkExecutor with fixed 80 ms async duration per writer call

metrics.integrity: observed_changes must equal 41 in each arm
metrics.secondary: last writer-call start minus final event submission time; scheduler start lag only

screening_rule: Coalesced arm must submit fewer writer jobs than control and preserve all 41 changes. No CPU or lifecycle-wall threshold is inferred from this mock benchmark.
